mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO home_project.transaction_history ( transaction_at, description, transaction_type, transaction_institution, account_number, amount, balance_after, memo, source_file_name, source_row_number ) VALUES
( #{item.transactionAt}, #{item.description}, #{item.transactionType}, #{item.transactionInstitution}, #{item.accountNumber}, #{item.amount}, #{item.balanceAfter}, #{item.memo}, #{item.sourceFileName}, #{item.sourceRowNumber} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, transaction_at, description, transaction_type, transaction_institution, account_number, amount, balance_after, memo FROM home_project.transaction_history WHERE transaction_at >= #{searchParam.startDateTime} AND transaction_at < #{searchParam.endDateTimeExclusive} ORDER BY transaction_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{searchParam.limit} OFFSET #{searchParam.offset}
